level: gate level (key caches), development logs only

read_outs.H3: mean over the calibration draws of the coverage (own edit released) of (T-Gen + I-Gen) / 2 on the odd edits at the smallest common raise of the scale with mean firing <= 10 percent on the fit hard negatives (fx.sweeps.h3, guards kept)
read_outs.H2: mean over the calibration draws of (T-Gen coverage + I-Gen coverage) / 2 on all edits (fx.metrics.gate_stats)

rules.h3_unreachable: a calibration draw on which no raise of the scale reaches 10 percent mean firing on the fit hard negatives (guard caps keep edits in scope) contributes H3 coverage 0 for that draw, for every method alike; the number of such draws is reported next to every H3 number
rules.ties: ties are broken by the order of fx.review1.COSINE_FAMILY / RETRIEVAL_FAMILY (the registered gate first)
rules.retr_top1: retr_sum / retr_min release by margin (R25, item 1)
rules.x_form: the _x form of a shared-scale gate is the two-block _x form (R25, item 2)
